answers.goal: My goal that I am working up to right now is being an A&R exec at Indie major label. But the ultimate goal is to start my own record label that is very artist forward that doesn't make artists feel like they are heard and they have a team to support them to get their creative vision across.
answers.drew: Music has been a part of my life since I was 4 but only as a hobby. Being able to do it as a career has been a dream. Waking up to never hate my job is probably the only thing I can ask for. Music is something everyone listens to no matter what, being able to be at the forefront of that is definitely what drew me to it.
answers.seeking: All sorts of creatives in the entertainment industry. Meeting more people in the music industry would be amazing also have been looking to connect with more videographers and photographers.
answers.inspiration: My dad is truly my biggest inspiration. He is where I get my motivation and drive to wake up every morning and go a step further than I was yesterday.
